src/controller_inference/init.py

Python · Tier A

Optional controller-owned inference management; omitted from external-only builds.

src/controller_inference/contracts.py

Python · Tier A

Keep HTTP and model-tool inference interfaces aligned by deriving strict argument models from management route signatures. argument_model owns schema conversion; contracts flattens routes and excludes internal operations. The maintained effect/internal sets control tool exposure, while manager.py owns authorization, revision checks and actual invocation.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
argument_model 95 Derive a strict Pydantic argument model from the shared HTTP handler signature, excluding FastAPI Request injection. Restrict instance lifecycle actions to their supported literals and add optional revision/idempotency fields for controller dispatch. Unknown input keys are rejected; required/default values follow the source handler.
contracts 116 Build the discoverable operation-to-route/model map from shared management and controller-only routers, flattening included routers and excluding internal worker/credential/stream/status operations. Constructing this catalog performs no manager startup or I/O; it supplies both typed tools and invocation validation.

src/controller_inference/manager.py

Python · Tier A

Integrate Portal lifecycle work with controller authority and model-request admission. InferenceManager persists operation intents/receipts, checks revisions, owns transition holds and publishes detached launches/bindings for dispatch. ManagedRoute applies the same boundary to HTTP and typed tool calls; extra_router adds connections, cache policy and operation views. Portal owns worker processes and its separate SQLite/secret stores. Accepted operations can outlive callers; failed cleanup or rollback keeps truthful durable state for recovery.

Significant symbols

Publish detached state for model dispatch and user observations; supervisor/process cleanup remains with Portal. Cleanup failure retains ownership for retry instead of reporting closed.

Wrap Portal state publication, create telemetry/status owners and assemble guarded shared/controller routes plus typed tool contracts. Optional controller services supply model routing, native admission and receipt ownership.

InferenceManager.start 687 Start management on the current event loop and reconcile nonterminal operations with durable native tool receipts. Interrupt unacknowledged agent intents rather than replaying them; queue recoverable operations, start Portal without independent instance restoration and publish ready state/bindings. Startup failures become redacted management errors and blocked operations. Recovery may be deferred until the controller is ready.
InferenceManager.resume_recovery 749 Launch recovered operation records once, then enqueue desired-running instances from their last successful request only when no recovered instance/service operation already owns restoration.
InferenceManager.close 766 Stop user observers, cancel/join lifecycle tasks and drain/close Portal while preserving restart intent. Mark closed only after successful cleanup; propagate cleanup failures and clear closing so the controller can retain and retry ownership.
InferenceManager.route_type 799 Create the integrated APIRoute wrapper that rejects direct local worker-protocol calls and cross-origin writes, extracts revision/idempotency context and enters the shared mutation guard. Require object JSON bodies, remove transport revision metadata before handler validation, return no-store responses and redact unexpected errors into logs/HTTP failures. Controller authentication is supplied by the enclosing application.
InferenceManager.guard 889 Scope actor context around UI/tool operations and serialize ordinary mutations, allowing immediate stop/force-stop/duplicate paths to bypass that lock. Coordinate server-update admission, require an eligible management phase and enforce resource or prompt-policy revisions before yielding. Publish/log successful changes, then release admission/context in finally; read-only calls only receive actor context.
InferenceManager.invoke 984 Validate a discoverable tool's arguments with the route-derived schema, separate concurrency/idempotency fields and build an agent actor tied to its run/invocation. Execute the same endpoint under the shared guard and unwrap JSONResponse data; unknown names fail before dispatch.
InferenceManager.record 1016 Merge operation changes into the latest durable record with an update timestamp, then project its status to the serving indicator through the nonfatal observation boundary.
InferenceManager.enqueue 1027 Persist a lifecycle intent with candidate/previous launch snapshots and actor scope. Reuse matching idempotency fingerprints, reject conflicting starts and let stop/delete/shutdown preempt active operations. User actions queue immediately; agent actions remain awaiting_receipt until the native result is durably accepted. Acceptance returns an operation record, not proof of completed launch.
InferenceManager.instance_action 1093 Adapt the shared management router's instance lifecycle callback to the controller's durable operation queue.
InferenceManager.after_receipt 1096 Only the native receipt hook may release a deferred agent operation.
InferenceManager.launch_operation 1104 Create one asynchronous lifecycle worker for an existing nonterminal operation unless its owned task is already running. Receipt/recovery callers control when deferred operations reach this entry point.
InferenceManager.cancel 1117 Cancel the owned lifecycle task when present and durably mark a nonterminal operation cancelled. Missing IDs return HTTP 404; terminal records remain unchanged, and task cleanup may still be completing.
InferenceManager.affected_endpoints 1130 Collect normalized published endpoints for the requested instance identities so transition holds and active-call inspection use native admission keys.
InferenceManager.active_calls 1140 Read detached active native model-admission leases for the supplied endpoints. Return no calls when controller services or the RAM-backed native store are unavailable.
InferenceManager.release_stopped_calls 1150 Worker exit ends active inference ownership even if local cleanup is stuck.
InferenceManager.affected_tasks 1166 Find nonterminal native runs whose accepted Main/Helper/Vision routing snapshot references the affected managed instances. Return run/status/binding identities for transition previews and compatibility checks without modifying task state.
InferenceManager.prepare_operation 1204 Fence new requests and record work without waiting for calls or checkpoint I/O.
InferenceManager.ready 1240 Poll persisted instance state every 200 milliseconds until ready or the monotonic deadline. Fail immediately on failed/stopped state, preserving its error, and raise TimeoutError if readiness never arrives.
InferenceManager.run_operation 1258 Apply a durable instance/service lifecycle intent while fencing affected endpoints and recording affected work. Respect predecessor cleanup; force-stop kills before waiting. Verify readiness and bound models after launches, release successful holds and record completion. A changed restart candidate may roll back to the previous successful snapshot; failed cleanup/restoration stays visible and fenced. Shutdown cancellation records recovering intent, and finally releases only newly acquired holds for unchanged failed work without a successor.
InferenceManager.service_action 1400 Drain shared Portal workers/jobs and dispose its tasks, supervisor and HTTP client for start/restart/shutdown. Restore previously desired-running snapshots for start/restart without letting Portal independently restore them; rotate the management boot ID on success. Shutdown remains stopped, and redacted failure state propagates to the operation owner.
InferenceManager.verify_bindings 1440 Validate served-model compatibility for current role bindings and historical bindings retained by affected accepted tasks after an instance launch changes.
InferenceManager.verify_embedding 1462 Resolve a binding's credential identity in the private Portal secret store, falling back to the local placeholder key when no secret exists.

Accept auto only when some model is served, require explicit choice for ambiguous inventories and reject a selected model absent from the endpoint.

src/controller_inference/skill.py

Python · Tier A

Expose shared inference management contracts to the agent's controller-local tool registry. InferenceTool builds the runtime tool definition and bridges synchronous execution to the manager event loop; build_skill declares discovery and resource actions. Redacted errors, unknown timeout effects and durable receipt IDs preserve truthful lifecycle reporting. Model-facing descriptions and schemas below are executable inputs and stay unchanged.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
manager_for 24 Resolve the inference manager from the tool context's product-management service, returning no manager when that controller service is absent.
available 31 Expose whether the current controller includes inference management for tool discovery. This checks manager presence; execute separately verifies that its event loop is running.
InferenceTool 41 Adapt one shared management operation into a controller-local typed tool. Its definition derives arguments/effect/confirmation from the source contract; execute bridges the synchronous tool worker to the manager loop and returns redacted, structured execution results.
InferenceTool.execute 70 Submit a validated manager invocation to its running event loop and wait up to 330 seconds. Report unavailable management without claiming execution, redact request failures and mark timeout effects unknown because durable work may continue. Matching awaiting-receipt lifecycle results carry an intent ID so the caller can persist the tool receipt before interrupting its own model.
build_skill 146 Construct inference adapters from discoverable contracts and publish their resource/action mappings for profiles, runtimes, models, hosts, jobs, preferences, connections, operations and controller caching. Use the authored prompt catalog for the skill description; declaring availability/resources does not execute those operations.

src/controller_inference/telemetry.py

Python · Tier A

Correlate existing model HTTP attempts, GPU samples and backend counters for the user timeline. Capture owns bounded in-memory records and cursor/retention semantics; Telemetry owns detached launch attribution, registered-host sampling and listener/task cleanup. The router binds each capture to its user and renewal lease. No prompts, responses or capture state are persisted, and starting/stopping observation neither submits inference nor changes worker configuration.
